title: Healthy Taco Salad
reject_reason: Ground-turkey taco-seasoned filling with salsa, corn, cheese and tortilla chips over romaine duplicates the saturated live turkey-taco family (casserole, rice skillet); it is also a cold plate, and the salad vehicle does not make a distinct dinner.
